subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should the native mobile Automations management scope land together with the additional post-merge Skills corrections, or should the PR be narrowed to Automations only?
rationale: The linked issue and protected maintainer label establish a native product-boundary decision, while combining two independently reviewable management surfaces increases rollback and ownership coupling beyond a mechanical fix.

options.title: Narrow to Automations
options.body: Fix the stale-diagnostics path and move the additional Skills corrections into a focused follow-up against the already-merged Skills implementation.

options.title: Approve Combined Scope
options.body: Keep both surfaces together only after the native-app owner explicitly accepts the larger review and rollback boundary.

options.title: Reduce Mobile Parity
options.body: Limit this PR to naming, search, and filtering while deferring the broader iOS management controls for separate product calibration.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Automations
recommendation.body: Fix the stale-diagnostics path and move the additional Skills corrections into a focused follow-up against the already-merged Skills implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history ties this person most directly to the native management surfaces and shared app implementation involved in the decision.
